description: r5:F2 — the Trukk is a SPEED FREEKS datasheet in Codex: Orks (11e) (Dedicated Transports: Trukk), but dataset 1.4.5 omitted the keyword, so DAKKASTORM / SPEEDIEST FREEKS were never offered on a Trukk. With the local data patch (scripts/40kdc/local-patches.mjs patch 4, re-applied to units.json, the army file and the ork11e fixtures) the Trukk carries SPEED FREEKS: a real click on the Trukk token in the Kult of Speed Shooting phase opens the unit_selected_to_shoot window with an enabled 'Use on Trukk' DAKKASTORM button; a real click spends 1 CP and gives the Trukk [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Setup-only: P1 switched to Kult of Speed; Custodian Guard C moved unengaged in range.

steps.comment: the fixture Trukk carries the codex SPEED FREEKS keyword
setup: switch P1 to Kult of Speed

steps.script:
var xs = [12.0, 14.0, 16.0, 18.0, 20.0]
var ms = GameState.state.units["U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_C"].models
for i in range(ms.size()):
	ms[i]["position"] = {"x": xs[i] * 40.0, "y": 22.0 * 40.0}
	ms[i]["wounds"] = 99
	ms[i]["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
steps.comment: setup: an unengaged enemy within the Trukk's range

steps.equals: Trukk has been selected to shoot
